notes: For balanced semiprimes p ≍ sqrt(N), the conjectured ECM bound becomes the displayed L_N[1/2,1] bound. This is a direct parameter specialization of the paper’s small-factor expression.

extra.derivation: Substitute log p = (1/2+o(1)) log N into sqrt(2 log p log log p).
